text: A token dose may not be enough to make the jaw release. More than once, I've dissolved **Dead Sea magnesium chloride hexahydrate flakes** in water and taken about **one gram per minute by mouth for around twenty minutes** before mine fully released. Around twenty grams is fine for my gut, and I've only had diarrhea above about forty grams. And magnesium chloride is [less likely to cause diarrhea than several other kinds of magnesium](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10509448/), including the ones people take on purpose as laxatives. I use it mostly because it's what I know works best: it absorbs faster and better than any other form, so you can see how it's helping, usually within a minute.
reader: a friend at a festival with someone who took MDMA a few hours ago, whose jaw has started to clench and grind, with magnesium chloride flakes in their bag, reading what to do
